ns2:course.label: Latina/o Social Movements
ns2:course.description: Determinants, dynamics and consequences of Latina/o social movements and public actions in the U.S.. Theories and history of social movements, and globalization and the new immigration, and transportational community formation. Case studies include the UFW, La Raza Party, and mobilization of Latina/o communities to address specific local issues. Prerequisite: LLS 100 or advisor' s permission. 3 Undergraduate Hours. 4 Graduate Hours.
